target.description: feature_id for plan review, package_id for implementation review.

coverage.description: Optional per-vendor coverage report added by add-deterministic-review-preprocessing. Absent means 'unreported' — the dispatcher treats an absent block as full coverage, never as a penalty.

skipped.description: Paths this vendor was asked to review but did not, with why.

rate.description: reviewed / (reviewed + skipped), computed by the dispatcher if the vendor did not supply it.

file_path.description: File path the finding relates to (optional, enables cross-vendor matching)

line_range.description: Line range within file_path (optional). Two shapes are accepted, matching consensus_synthesizer._parse_line_range: the canonical object form, and the bare string form ('10' or '10-20') that vendors emit in practice. The parser was widened to accept the string; this schema was not, so the CLI replay path rejected documents the in-process path consumed fine. Keep the two in step.

axis.description: 8-axis review categorization (5 code-review axes plus the fitness-function axes observability, resilience, compatibility)

evidence_class.description: How this finding was established. 'deterministic' means a reproducible observation — a test failed, a schema mismatched, a scanner rule fired; re-running the same input yields the same finding, and a seeded defect can prove the detector works. 'judgment' means a model reasoned about the artifact; the finding may be correct and valuable but is not reproducible and cannot be falsified by seeding a defect. Only deterministic findings are counted as blocking by the consensus synthesizer. Optional and defaulting to 'deterministic' so existing emitters are unchanged; callers dispatching a judgment-class reviewer declare it at ingest rather than trusting the model to self-label.

existing_code.description: Optional verbatim excerpt of one or more consecutive lines from the reviewed diff that this finding targets, added by add-deterministic-review-preprocessing. Leading diff markers ('+'/'-') and surrounding whitespace are ignored by the ingest-time line resolver; a vendor-supplied line_range still wins when both are present.

line_resolution.description: How line_range was determined, added by add-deterministic-review-preprocessing. 'vendor' means the vendor supplied a usable line_range directly; 'hunk_new'/'hunk_old'/'file' mean the ingest-time resolver matched existing_code on that side of the diff or in the full file; 'unresolved' means matching failed and line_range is absent (the finding is kept regardless).
